docs.text:
SpineLeaf E-Book Reader

Welcome to the documentation for SpineLeaf, a modern E-Book and PDF reader application built with Flutter and Material 3.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: SpineLeaf provides a comprehensive reading experience, featuring EPUB and PDF parsing, local database storage, detailed reading statistics, and an innovative RSVP (Rapid Serial Visual Presentation) speed-reading mode.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text: Welcome to SpineLeaf! You can install the application either by downloading pre-compiled binaries or by building it from the source code.

docs.title: Download Pre-compiled Binaries
docs.text:
For most users, downloading the pre-compiled binary is the easiest way to get started.

Download the latest release for Android and IOS here

docs.title: Build from Source
docs.text: If you prefer to compile the application yourself, you will need the Flutter SDK installed on your system.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Flutter SDK (Version 3.0.0 or higher)
  • Appropriate toolchains for your platform (e.g., Android Studio for Android, Xcode for iOS/macOS, Visual Studio for Windows).

docs.title: Build Instructions
docs.text:
1. Clone the repository: bash git clone https://github.com/PippyUrkel/spineleaf.git cd spineleaf

  2. Fetch dependencies: bash flutter pub get

  3. Run the application locally: bash flutter run

  4. Build the release version: Choose your target platform below to build the final executable.

  5. Android (APK): flutter build apk --release

  6. Android (AppBundle): flutter build appbundle --release
  7. iOS: flutter build ios --release
  8. macOS: flutter build macos --release
  9. Windows: flutter build windows --release
  10. Linux: flutter build linux --release

docs.title: The Library View
docs.text:
The Library is the central hub of SpineLeaf, providing quick access to your entire collection while keeping your reading progress organized and easy to manage.

Continue Reading Resume books instantly from your last reading position. Reading States Organize books into Unread, Reading and Completed collections. Library Views Switch between grid and list layouts to browse comfortably. Import Books Add EPUB, PDF and other supported formats directly to your library. Search & Statistics Quickly locate books and monitor your reading activity.

docs.title: Importing Books
docs.text:
SpineLeaf makes importing books effortless. Browse your device, select one or multiple supported files, and they'll be added directly to your personal library with their metadata extracted automatically wherever possible.

Multiple Formats Import EPUB, PDF, MOBI and other supported reading formats. Native File Picker Select books directly from your device using the system file browser. Bulk Import Import multiple books in a single operation to quickly build your library. Automatic Metadata Book information and cover artwork are detected whenever available. Instant Availability Newly imported books appear immediately in your library and are ready to read.

docs.title: Book Details
docs.text:
The Book Details page provides a comprehensive overview of a selected title, including reading progress, metadata, and chapter navigation. From here, readers can jump to any chapter and manage their reading progress with bulk chapter actions.

Chapter Navigation Browse the complete chapter list and open any chapter directly from the details page. Bulk Selection Select multiple chapters simultaneously for efficient progress management. Reading Progress Mark selected chapters as read or unread to keep your reading history synchronized. Progress Tracking Monitor chapter completion percentage and seamlessly continue reading from your last position.

docs.title: Reading Experience
docs.text: SpineLeaf supports a rich reading experience for both EPUB and PDF files.

docs.title: Reader Interface
docs.text:
SpineLeaf's reader is designed to minimize distractions while keeping essential tools within easy reach. Navigation controls, reading progress, and quick actions are always accessible without interrupting the reading experience.

Immersive Reading A clean interface prioritizes book content while minimizing visual distractions. Reading Progress Navigate chapters quickly using the integrated progress slider and page indicator. Quick Actions Access the Table of Contents, Reader Settings, Bookmarks, and additional tools from the bottom toolbar. Distraction-Free Controls Reader controls remain unobtrusive and can be accessed only when needed, allowing the focus to stay on the text.

docs.title: Reader Controls
docs.text:
Reader controls are designed to feel natural and unobtrusive, allowing navigation through a book using simple gestures while keeping essential reading tools only a tap away.

Page Navigation Swipe left or right to move seamlessly between pages in paginated reading mode. Quick Access Menu Open the reader menu from the top-right corner to access additional reading tools and options. Context-Aware Controls Reader controls remain unobtrusive during reading and appear only when interaction is required. Fluid Reading Experience Navigation and menu interactions are optimized to keep transitions smooth and responsive throughout the reading session.

docs.title: Reader Settings
docs.text:
Reader Settings allow every aspect of the reading experience to be personalized. From typography and themes to layout and navigation, each option is designed to help readers create a comfortable reading environment tailored to their preferences.

Reading Modes Switch between paginated and continuous scrolling modes depending on your preferred reading style. Themes Choose from Light, Sepia, Dark, and Night themes to suit different lighting conditions. Typography Customize font family, font size, line spacing, margins, and text alignment for optimal readability. Live Preview Changes are applied instantly, allowing you to preview adjustments without leaving the reader.

docs.title: Dictionary
docs.text:
The integrated dictionary allows readers to instantly look up the meaning of unfamiliar words without leaving the reading session. Definitions are displayed contextually, helping maintain reading flow while improving comprehension.

Contextual Lookup Select any word while reading and retrieve its definition directly within the reader. Seamless Reading Access word definitions without switching applications or interrupting your reading session. Detailed Definitions View concise meanings and supporting information to better understand unfamiliar vocabulary. Integrated Reader Experience Dictionary functionality is fully integrated into the reading interface for quick and intuitive access. Supports Continuous Learning Encourage vocabulary building while maintaining focus on the book, making every reading session an opportunity to learn.

docs.title: RSVP Speed Reading
docs.text: SpineLeaf includes an innovative Rapid Serial Visual Presentation (RSVP) mode for speed reading.

docs.title: RSVP Mode
docs.text:
RSVP (Rapid Serial Visual Presentation) presents one word at a time at a fixed focal point, minimizing eye movement and allowing readers to maintain concentration while increasing reading speed. It provides an alternative reading experience tailored for speed reading and focused text consumption.

Speed Reading Read significantly faster by presenting words sequentially at a fixed position, reducing unnecessary eye movement. Adjustable Reading Pace Select from preset speeds or fine-tune the words-per-minute rate to match your reading comfort. Playback Controls Pause, resume, skip forwards or backwards, and quickly revisit recently displayed words without leaving the session. Progress Awareness Monitor your current chapter and overall reading progress while remaining immersed in the reading flow. Focused Reading Ideal for quickly consuming articles, documentation, and fiction while minimizing visual distractions and maintaining attention.

docs.title: Settings & Customization
docs.text: Personalize your reading experience by tweaking SpineLeaf's settings.

docs.title: Settings
docs.text:
SpineLeaf provides a centralized settings page for customizing the application's appearance, reading preferences, library behavior, and supporting services. Changes are applied instantly, allowing users to personalize the application to match their workflow and reading style.

Appearance Switch between System, Light, and Dark themes while customizing the application's accent color. Reading Preferences Configure default reader themes, font size, and scrolling behavior before opening a book. Dictionary Integration Choose your preferred dictionary provider for quick word lookups while reading. Instant Customization Theme and appearance changes are reflected immediately throughout the application without requiring a restart.

docs.title: Statistics
docs.text:
The Statistics dashboard provides a concise overview of your reading habits, helping you monitor progress, maintain consistency, and gain insights into your reading journey over time.

Reading Activity Track today's reading time alongside your cumulative reading hours. Progress Overview View completed books, active reads, and total chapters read across your library. Reading Streaks Stay motivated by maintaining daily reading streaks and consistent reading habits. Weekly Activity Visualize your reading activity throughout the week with an easy-to-read activity chart.
